test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Certain
solution:
The correct answer is **Sure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Certain: **definite

 
 
• For example, Divya is **certain** about the consequences of her plan. 
 
 
 
• Sure: without any doubt, certain.

Hence, the appropriate synonym of **Certain** is **Sure**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Doubtful:** feeling uncertain about something.
 
• **Hesitant:** tentative, unsure.
 
• **Doubting:** expressing or feeling uncertainty or lack of conviction.
